Weddings at The Heart of England

Welcome to Weddings at The Heart of England, a stunning wedding venue nestled in the Warwickshire Countryside. We are honoured that you are considering us for your special day and cannot wait to help you create unforgettable memories.

Our versatile property offers a range of ceremony and party rooms, extensive grounds, and a marquee with breathtaking views of the rolling countryside. Whether you envision an intimate gathering or a grand celebration, we welcome you with open arms.

WE OFFER A DIVERSE RANGE OF CEREMONIES & WEDDINGS

ASIAN WEDDINGS | SIKH WEDDINGS | MUSLIM WEDDINGS | HINDU WEDDINGS | ENGLISH WEDDINGS | FUSION WEDDINGS
DIVERSE WEDDINGS | LGBTQ+ WEDDINGS | EVERYONE IS WELCOME

Our team is committed to supporting you every step of the way, no matter the size of your celebration. We understand that planning a wedding can be stressful, which is why we offer a range of services to make the process as smooth as possible.

In addition to our beautiful venue, we offer stunning photo opportunities with our park, secluded woodland, lakes, and jetties. Our goal is to create unforgettable memories that will last a lifetime for you and your guests.

Thank you for considering The Heart of England as your wedding venue. We cannot wait to celebrate your love with you in Coventry!

Working together to build the day of your dreams!

We’d love to help make your wedding day unforgettable here at the Heart of England. Our Wedding Manager is experienced in creating unique weddings that are tailored to your preferences. We’ll be there every step of the way to help with room styling ideas, unique catering packages, and managing all the details. Whether you’re dreaming of a modern or traditional, vintage, quirky, or totally bespoke wedding, we invite you to schedule a personal tour of our wedding suites and grounds. Let’s work together to build the day of your dreams!

WHAT OUR COUPLES SAY...

From the very first meeting to the final moments of our wedding day, Nim was nothing short of incredible. Her attention to detail, calm professionalism, and genuine care made the whole journey so special. She truly went above and beyond to bring our vision to life, Nim you are an absolute star and such an asset to the team! A huge thank you also to Erika, who was such a huge support on the day itself everything ran so smoothly, and we couldn’t have asked for a more dedicated and caring team around us. The venue looked absolutely breathtaking. The Heart of England team worked wonders with all the lighting and extras we had requested. Our reception party looked like something straight out of a movie! The transition from canapés to the evening reception was seamless, and every single space looked stunning. The beautiful grounds created the perfect backdrop for our guests and made our day feel truly magical. We honestly can’t thank Nim, Erika, and the entire team enough for making our wedding day unforgettable. You brought our dreams to life, and we can’t wait to return for our next event!

Karena and Gurpal
4th October, 2025

Thank you so much again for the brilliant service and hosting my dream wedding, the venue and staff are amazing! Thank you also to Adrian who made many plans for us! Really appreciate everything.  Will definitely be recommending the venue to everyone!

Thanks from the family for a wonderful day yesterday. The venue was great, everything was absolutely spot on and made Lisa and Emma’s day a wonderful occasion. Massive shout out and thanks to Kelly and all the team who were super, nothing was too much trouble and we had a great time.

We got married and had our reception at the Heart of England conference centre. We can honestly say the venue and staff were amazing from start to finish. We would highly recommend this venue for a wedding. It was just perfect. We can't thank the Heart of England staff enough. Absolutely superb.

Escape to Heart House – Where Comfort Meets Adventure

Discover the perfect blend of relaxation and excitement at Heart House, the exclusive accommodation at the Heart of England Conference and Events Centre.

With 10 stylish and modern bedrooms in a welcoming bed and breakfast, charming glamping pods and shepherd huts (some complete with hot tubs), and a cosy log cabin, there's something for every kind of stay – whether it's a romantic retreat, group getaway, or family adventure.

Close to road, rail and air networks. 10 minutes to Birmingham NEC,

7 miles to Birmingham International Airport, Train Station & NEC

Upgrade your stay with thrilling activity packages, including quad biking, archery, and more –

All our bedrooms have been beautifully furnished with solid oak furniture and luxurious soft furnishings, creating a relaxing and sumptuous environment to relax in. All rooms have large screen tv's and tea and coffee making facilities.
